# The Gantt Now Line test samples a stale header marker

## Context

The Engine test matrix for #22007 failed in the Neo Light Gantt Now Line case. One of five runs of the unchanged test on the exact `dev` parent `9f0c242251cb1182ff7f08fc884f47b178ba199e` produced the same 291 px mismatch. The contributor change is confined to two functional examples. [Hosted shard](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/actions/runs/45061649291/job/137328726308)

## The Problem

`test/playwright/e2e/gantt/NowLine.spec.mjs:135` expects the body mark and header mark within 0.5 px. Two of eight diagnostic runs captured the header at x=722 and the body at x=1013 when the assertion read them. The header and body were both x=1013 on the next observed animation frame and remained there for three more frames. The seam and row gaps stayed at 0.

## The Architectural Reality

The test sets the axis instant and the viewport theme in the App Worker. Both marks can already be visible with their preceding offsets when that evaluation returns. `TimeAxisHeader.mjs` and `Column.mjs` each publish a marker from `TimeAxis#getNowOffset()`; the current visibility checks do not establish that both rendered marks represent the requested instant.

Design authority: the spec measures the resulting line from rendered rects across the header and rows.

## The Fix

Wait for the header and row markers to represent the requested axis offset before taking the existing geometry measurements. Base readiness on the requested instant and rendered marker values. Keep the existing alignment, seam, edge, tick and band assertions.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The test's readiness check distinguishes the requested instant from an earlier pair of visible markers.
- [ ] The complete Now Line spec and repeated runs of the Neo Light Gantt case pass. An incorrect marker or a stable rectangle misalignment still fails.
- [ ] The change is confined to the test fixture.

## Out of Scope

Production timeline layout, theme changes, shard limits, and the other CI failure on #22007.
